idea-plugin.name: Commit Helper
idea-plugin.description: Organizes the changes you have checked in the commit panel into a ready-to-commit message: a subject line plus an itemized body. Local, deterministic grouping runs first; an optional LLM (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic or Gemini) only handles the wording. If the model is unavailable the plugin falls back to the local grouping result instead of failing. Settings includes an in-IDE Guide tab with a 3-step setup, prompt/template field reference, a live configuration self-check and the most common misconfiguration (pasting field labels or {text} into Format template). Project defaults are the fourth settings tab, and every page adapts to the IDE window width. The plugin description, README and change notes ship the same setup/troubleshooting guidance.

action.description: Organize the checked changes into a commit message (local grouping + optional LLM wording)
Generate a commit message with extra context: issue links, notes and Skip CI
Reformat the existing commit message with the selected template (LLM)
Generate a changelog for the checked changes and a PR description for the current branch
